name: ESEE-4 Fixed Blade Knife
summary: A compact fixed-blade reference for campsite cutting and field repairs. The selected configuration has a black blade, gray handle and black sheath with belt attachment; confirm the exact steel and package on the selected offer.
description: The ESEE-4 fits a field kit where a compact fixed blade is useful but a larger chopping tool would be cumbersome. This profile compares the manufacturer’s coated carbon-steel reference, with attention to sheath storage and edge care. ESEE lists several steels and sheath combinations in the wider family, so dimensions alone do not identify a retail package. The selected reference has gray Micarta scales and a black sheath with belt attachment. Match the actual scale material, steel and supplied sheath on the chosen offer; this profile does not guarantee delivered accessories.
